_comment: Last-touched: 2026-08-14 - corrected after the badge was earned. Answers every passing-level
criterion for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, so registration and re-runs auto-fill.
Read by bestpractices.dev when the project is registered and when 'Save (and continue)' is
WHAT THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS FILE GOT WRONG, so it is not reintroduced:
1. It left three criteria as '?' 'to be safe'. Two of them are MUST criteria, and a '?' on a
MUST is not caution - it is a failing answer. The badge cannot reach passing with them unset.
2. It gave a status with no justification for four criteria that carry
'met_url_required: true' in criteria.yml. A Met whose justification contains no URL does not
count, and BadgeApp displays its own placeholder text in place of the missing reason. The
badge stalled at 94% with every criterion reading Met until URLs were supplied.
Both defects share one cause: the file's syntax was validated and never cross-checked against
the criteria metadata. Before trusting this file again, run the check in
reports any status that is missing a required justification or URL.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/Novaza-ai/freeholdmail/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - CONTRIBUTING.md states the test suites CI gates on, and that changes ship with tests.
documentation_interface_justification: docs/HOSTING.md walks from a bare VPS to a working mailbox with a verification command at every step.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and GitHub Discussions are both enabled on the repository.
english_justification: English is authoritative; 11 further translations are listed in TRANSLATIONS.md.
release_notes_vulns_justification: The changelog names GHSA-8jqj-qj5p-v5rr and the Keycloak 26.7.1 patch floor explicitly.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/Novaza-ai/freeholdmail/security/advisories - GitHub private security advisories are enabled, and SECURITY.md also gives admin@novaza.ai as an alternative channel.
test_justification: tests/test_config.sh and tests/test_e2e.sh; the e2e test sends a real message SMTP to mailbox to IMAP and matches it by Message-ID.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on every push and pull request.
warnings_justification: shellcheck runs in CI over install.sh and the test suites; the build fails on findings.
know_secure_design_justification: SECURITY.md documents the threat model and, separately, the controls the project explicitly does not claim.
crypto_call_justification: The project implements no cryptography of its own. TLS is terminated by nginx and secrets are generated with OpenSSL.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: nginx is configured ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3 only; the test suite asserts TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are refused.
crypto_random_justification: install.sh generates every secret with 'openssl rand -base64 32'. There is no default or hardcoded password anywhere in the project.
delivery_mitm_justification: Cloned over HTTPS; every container image is pinned to a sha256 digest and CI fails if any resolved image is not; releases carry SHA256SUMS and SLSA provenance.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Most recent example: Keycloak 26.7.0 was below the 26.7.1 patch floor and was fixed the same day it was found, 2026-08-13.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and scripts/check_disclosure.py gates every push with an allow-list of what the repository may mention.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL runs in .github/workflows/ci.yml. OpenSSF Scorecard scores this project's SAST check 10/10.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Zero open CodeQL alerts as of 2026-08-14.
dynamic_analysis_justification: CI boots the real stack every run and exercises it with live SMTP and IMAP traffic rather than mocks.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The software produced by this project is shell and Python orchestration. The memory-unsafe components in the deployed stack (nginx, PostgreSQL) are upstream and unmodified; the mail server and webmail are Rust.
_unanswered: Nothing is left unanswered. All 67 passing-level criteria carry a status, and every criterion
that requires a justification or a URL now has one.

report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been submitted. The repository became public on 2026-08-05 and has received zero non-pull-request issues to date, so there is no backlog of unacknowledged reports.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been submitted since the repository became public on 2026-08-05.
